name: Rexnord Electronics and Controls Limited
summary: Rexnord Electronics & Controls Ltd., an Indian holding company, primarily focuses on the manufacturing and sale of cooling fans designed for instruments, alongside various motor types. Its comprehensive product offerings encompass plastic impeller fans, metal impeller fans, energy-efficient fans, agitator motors, motors fitted with basket grills, and finger guards. The company was founded on July 4, 1988, by Kishore Chand Talwar and operates from its headquarters in Mumbai, India.
